segment.source: Renders the entries as a single horizontal row that scrolls with snap points instead of wrapping, keeping the band one screen tall no matter how many entries there are. Use it for: long capability sets on a short page, mobile-first landing pages, module ranges too wide for a grid, product line overviews. Prefer 'Feature Grid' when readers must see everything without scrolling sideways, and 'Capability Tabs' when they should pick one entry rather than browse them all.
